data.Q: In whom do the citizens of Shechem put their trust?
When do the people curse Abimelek?
data.A: During the eating and drinking at the festival

data.Q: Zebul serves as deputy to whom?
If Gaal leads the people, whom does he plan to remove?
Whom does Gaal urge the Shechemites to serve?
data.A: The family of Hamor, Shechem’s father

data.Q: What do the people do before the festival?
data.A: The people go to the fields, gather grapes, and tread the grapes
